# Sem imigração

```{r}
pacman::p_load(plotly)

source("funcs.R")

obj = BDP(a = 19, t_max = 6,
          lambda_k = lambda_k_simple_linear, mu_k = mu_k_simple_linear,
          theta = c(0.5, 0.3))
plotly_process(obj)
```

# Com imigracao
